content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab BV Netherlands to GitLab LTD UK, how do the employer contribution rates differ for the pension plans?","answer":"In the Netherlands GitLab contributes 3% of the pension base, while in the UK GitLab contributes 4% of basic salary.","evidence_a":"You contribute 2%, GitLab contributes 3%","evidence_b":"GitLab contributes 4% of your basic salary"}
